title: Cover usage_report.py before splitting it
objective: usage_report.py is 426 lines against a 250-line cap and sat at 47% coverage, with the uncovered half being the CLI, the two run paths, the clipboard/emit side and the segment aggregation - i.e. most of what a split would move. This commit raises it to 100% line and branch coverage first, so the following split can be verified against tests that predate the seam. No production code changes here.
acceptance_criteria: usage_report.py reaches 100% line and branch coverage, from 47%
usage_report.py is byte-identical to HEAD - this commit adds tests only
The directory test count rises by exactly the number of tests added (179 -> 204) with no existing test altered
No suppression of any kind: no noqa, no type: ignore, no lowered threshold
Every new test file is under the 250-line cap, so the over-cap total does not rise
out_of_scope: The split of usage_report.py itself, which is the next commit
Deleting the dead _compute_window shim - a behaviour change that does not belong in a coverage commit
meta/scripts/optimize_vscode.py and the three transcribe_* files, also over cap and untested
verifier: pytest linux_configuration/tests/ --cov=usage_report --cov-branch --cov-report=term-missing for the coverage claim and the test count; pre-commit run --files for lint; bash ~/utils/scripts/check_file_length.sh --all to confirm no new over-cap file.
